about: The pin for src/assets/obs/tz-country.json, the estate's one shared time-zone-to-country table (dev@PrompTugal.dinis). Copied by live.b@PrompTugal.dinis on 19 Nov 2026 (1.0.0; 1.1.0 at about 05:15 UTC) from https://promptugal.news/assets/obs/tz-country.json and checked then against the full integrity string in the registry's obs_tz. The validator checks the file against this hash (the first 40 hex characters of its sha256); each build also checks it against the registry's full integrity string while the registry names the same version. When the registry names a newer version, the build ships no table (so no country is sent) and deploys the rest; the next wake upgrades it.
